_comment: The chrome palette of Design/Interface.md 3 and the eight commander colours of GameDesign.md 11 (owner, 2026-09-19). Every colour is 8-bit RGBA and is written as authored: a chrome colour is never lit, and the ruling of GameDesign.md 11 draws a commander's colour unlit too. The commander list is in seat order and is exactly as long as Sim's MAX_SEATS. Seats 0 to 3 are Species's own team colours from GameLogic/Location.cpp:248, byte for byte; Species could not supply the other four, because of the eight it declares it comments four out and those four repeat three of the first: its team 4 is team 3's blue, its team 5 is team 0's green, its team 6 is team 2's yellow. Grey is Species's team 7 lifted from 150, because it is read at one pixel on the minimap against fog-darkened terrain rather than as a billboard. The three new colours are placed as far from the inherited five as those allow: the closest pair of the eight is seat 3 against seat 7, both Species's, at 145 over the three channels. Every seat but 2 stands at least 200 from accent (255, 196, 64), which Interface.md 7 draws the selection in over whatever colour the object had; seat 2 stands 93 from it, and that pair is fixed by the two decisions either side of it - Species's yellow and the document's amber.
_icons: The icon table of Design/Interface.md 11 row 7: which 32x32 cell of Textures/Icons.dds is which icon. A structure or a module names its icon by its own content id - Structure<id>, Module<id> - and the cursors, orders and stances are the fixed sets sections 4, 6 and 9 list. The sheet is Tools/MakeIconAtlas.py's placeholder art, one distinct simple shape a cell, as Tools/MakePlaceholderModels.py's boxes are placeholder models; a few shapes repeat where the placeholder has nothing better to say - the chevron is Move, the order Move and the Pursue stance - and the NAMES are distinct so that the owner's art replaces one cell at a time.
